_comment: Registry of the S3 buckets in account 000000000000, discovered 2026-09-07.
Mirrors what `aws s3 ls` returns — keep in sync when buckets are added or retired.
in_scope=true means list it and ingest it. in_scope=false means audited-and-excluded
(deferred by the project owner, or out of project scope). in_scope=null means undecided.
site_id is a short id for the source website a bucket backs up, where one is known.
Counts are from the first discovery pass and are indicative, not authoritative —
scripts/s3_list_buckets.py writes exact figures to data/raw/inventory/<bucket>.meta.json.

buckets.name: www.forest-library.example
buckets.notes: Largest bucket by far — 83% of the corpus by size. 49k PDFs, 49k JPGs. Also holds ~29k .eml files; see exclude_prefixes.

buckets.name: www.forest-stewards.example
buckets.notes: Largely whole-server FTP backups; content sits alongside CMS code. See exclude_prefixes.

buckets.name: www.woodlands-council.example
buckets.notes: 575 PDFs + 493 .docx. The live site is now a stub, so this bucket may be the only surviving copy.

buckets.name: www.clearcut-watch.example
buckets.notes: Only bucket outside us-east-1. Any aws CLI call against it needs --region us-east-2.

buckets.name: www.timberland-network.example
buckets.notes: Not in the original site list; possibly the unnamed seventh site. Raw WordPress install dump (6,158 .php files), not extracted content.

buckets.name: Publications
buckets.notes: Seven objects: four Keynote decks, one PDF, one PPT. Oldest bucket (2013). Provenance unknown.

buckets.name: personal-media
buckets.notes: DEFERRED by the project owner 2026-09-07. Personal media archive, not a website: 14k photos, 5k mp3, 2.6k m4a, 2.2k .mov. Holds 2,465 PDFs that may be worth revisiting separately.

_comment: Keys under these prefixes are listed for the inventory but must NOT be ingested
without an explicit decision. Two categories:
(1) CMS and server code: the buckets hold whole-server FTP backups, so they contain
the web application itself (admin endpoints, editors, plugins), not publishable content.
(2) Personal correspondence: needs the author's consent before any of it is indexed.

_pending_consent._comment: Excluded pending an explicit decision from the founder.
_pending_consent.notes: Personal email correspondence across www.forest-library.example. Default: excluded.

open_questions: Is www.timberland-network.example the seventh site, and do we want the WordPress dump or a fresh extraction?
What are the ~29,000 .eml files in www.forest-library.example, and is any of that correspondence publishable? Default: excluded until the founder says otherwise.
What is the 'Publications' bucket and who created it?
No bucket exists for field-notes.example or canopy-archive.example — both need fresh scrapes.
